answer: Resist sybils with a scarce heartbeat franchise, not a signup fee. The network auctions a fixed set of pulse licenses; each is a copper-backed bond that lets one identity emit an epoch heartbeat. Licenses cannot be stacked on one host or transferred mid-epoch. A roaming sparrow checker pings holders at random and flags replies that share a clock, NIC, or route fingerprint. Shared fingerprints burn both bonds, so clones become a correlated loss instead of a cheap multiplier.
